scope: fixed uncalibrated S8 H0, real Bridge/Session/Host/Device; no GPU
initial_state: fresh Session; ordinary write initializes same 64KiB completely; no cache reset or warm/cold hardware claim
count_oracle: raw source intersection, request-relative 4096B chunks, independent 64B addresses; single channel global_base=0

fit.model: independent affine least-squares in five size bins, discontinuities allowed; bins right-closed
fit.acceptance: all five held-out relative errors <=5%; engineering predictive tolerance, not hardware accuracy
fit.basis: 32-fragment threshold; 4096B chunks/pages, two/four chunk boundaries and 256-fragment residency; candidate, not guaranteed true breakpoints

invalid: any independent count/address/content/drain failure excludes point from fitting and fails audit; no silent deletion
